chinese: 解释，说明（原因）；（数量上）占（比例）

example.question: The poor weather may have ______ the small crowd that attended the outdoor concert.
example.explanation: account for意为“解释、说明原因”，符合恶劣天气导致观众稀少的语境；account不与to/with/on构成此义，其余为形近搭配干扰项。

example.question: At the meeting, a junior engineer ______ a proposal that greatly reduced production costs.
example.explanation: put forward表示“提出（建议）”；put out为“扑灭”，put off为“推迟”，put up为“张贴、举起”，均与proposal不搭。

example.question: The police have not yet ______ the possibility that the fire was started deliberately.
example.explanation: rule out the possibility为固定表达，意为“排除可能性”；rule over指“统治”，rule against指“裁决对……不利”，rule off无此搭配。

example.question: Her fluent French made her ______ among the other applicants for the post.
example.explanation: stand out意为“引人注目、脱颖而出”，符合流利法语使其突出的语境；stand by为“支持、袖手旁观”，stand up为“起立”，stand for为“代表”。

example.question: After hours of discussion, the team finally ______ a workable solution to the software bug.
example.explanation: come up with意为“想出（办法）”；come up to为“达到”，come up against为“遭遇（困难）”，come up for无此固定搭配。

chinese: 受……支配；须服从于；易遭受

example.question: All employees ______ security checks before entering the research laboratory.
example.explanation: be subject to为固定短语，意为“须服从、须接受”；subjective意为“主观的”，语义不通；subject为形容词时须与be动词连用，故subject to结构不完整。

example.question: Don't worry. With so little experience, he ______ make a few mistakes at first.
example.explanation: be bound to do表示“必定会做”；be bound for指“开往（某地）”，bounds to和is bounded to均为错误搭配。

example.question: The job is not especially rewarding ______ salary, but the working atmosphere is wonderful.
example.explanation: in terms of为固定短语，意为“在薪水方面”；term必须用复数，且介词只能用in，其余三项均为形式干扰。

example.question: The outdoor graduation ceremony will be held as planned, ______ the weather.
example.explanation: regardless of表示“不管、不顾”；regarding本身是介词，不再加of；regarded to语态与搭配皆误，regardless with为错误介词。

example.question: The manager accepted the award ______ the whole sales department.
example.explanation: on behalf of为固定表达，意为“代表”；其余三项介词搭配均不成立，属形近干扰。

example.question: The author ______ the failure of the novel to poor marketing rather than to lack of talent.
example.explanation: attribute sth to sth意为“把……归因于”；contribute to指“促成、投稿”，distribute为“分配”，devote为“致力于”，均不符合归因含义。

example.question: Children who ______ a second language at an early age tend to acquire it more easily.
example.explanation: be exposed to在此意为“接触到”，须用被动结构；expose to语态错误，exposing with与exposed of介词搭配均不成立。

chinese: 促成，有助于；向……投稿/捐款

example.question: Regular exercise and a balanced diet both ______ good health and a longer life.
example.explanation: contribute to表示“有助于、促成”；contribute不与for搭配；attribute to是“把……归因于”，主语应为归因者；distribute to为“分发给”。

example.question: It took the exchange student several months to ______ life in a completely new culture.
example.explanation: adapt to意为“适应”；adopt是“采纳、收养”，adept是形容词“熟练的”，adapt for指“为……改编”，均不合语境。

example.question: Every member of the expedition must ______ the safety rules drawn up by the guide.
example.explanation: adhere to表示“遵守、坚持（规则）”；adhere只能与介词to搭配，其余三项均为错误搭配。

example.question: This year's National Day holiday ______ the Mid-Autumn Festival, creating an unusually long break.
example.explanation: coincide with指“与……同时发生、恰逢”；collide with指“（物体）相撞”，语义不符；coincide不与to搭配，consist with不成立。

example.question: Many elderly people find it hard to ______ the rapid changes brought by digital technology.
example.explanation: cope with为固定短语，意为“应对”；cope up是学生常犯的错误形式，against与for均不能与cope搭配表达此义。

example.question: Many common English words, such as telephone, ______ Greek roots.
example.explanation: derive from意为“源自、起源于”；deprive sb of sth为“剥夺”，derive不与to搭配，deride意为“嘲笑”，为形近干扰。

example.question: Full-time workers in this company ______ paid annual leave of at least ten days.
example.explanation: be entitled to表示“有权享有”，须用被动；titled指“有头衔的”，entitle to语态错误，entitling to进行时不当。

example.question: He moved to a quieter neighbourhood ______ his young children's health.
example.explanation: for the sake of为固定短语，意为“为了……的缘故”；其余三项介词结构均不成立。

example.question: The new tax policy gave ______ widespread dissatisfaction among small business owners.
example.explanation: give rise to为固定表达，意为“引起、导致”；give way to意为“让步于、被……取代”，语义相反；raise to和rise for搭配不成立。

example.question: Even after becoming famous, the writer ______ the simple habits of his youth.
example.explanation: hold on to在此意为“保持、不放弃（习惯）”；hold out为“坚持抵抗”，hold up为“举起、耽搁”，hold off为“推迟”，均不接to表达此义。

example.question: ______, the years I spent at university were the happiest of my life.
example.explanation: in retrospect为独立的评注性状语，不加of等介词；on/with retrospect均为错误搭配。

chinese: 与……并驾齐驱，跟上……的步伐

example.question: Small shops can hardly ______ the changing demands of modern consumers.
example.explanation: keep pace with表示“与……同步”，介词固定为with；keep up pace with与make pace with均为不规范表达，英语说keep up with而非keep up pace with。

chinese: 不辜负；符合，达到（期望、标准）

example.question: The sequel, unfortunately, failed to ______ the high expectations of the fans.
example.explanation: live up to one's expectations为固定搭配，意为“达到期望”；live with为“忍受”，live through为“度过（难关）”，live on为“靠……生活”。

example.question: The instructions were so poorly translated that no one could ______ them.
example.explanation: make sense of sth意为“弄懂某事物”；make sense of中sense不加冠词；make sense to后接人，for不能用于此结构。

example.question: After three years of losses, the small factory was ______ collapse.
example.explanation: on the verge of为固定短语，介词用on和of，意为“濒临”；其余三项介词均为错误组合。

example.question: Faced with two equally attractive offers, she finally ______ the one closer to home.
example.explanation: opt for后接名词，意为“选择”；opt to后须接动词原形；opt in指“决定加入”；opt against指“决定不选”，与语境相反。

example.question: All passengers must fasten their seat belts ______ take-off.
example.explanation: prior to相当于before，表示“在……之前”；无prior than此用法；superior to为“优于”，preferable to为“更可取”，语义不符。

chinese: 诉诸，求助于（常含不得已之意）

example.question: We hope to settle the dispute through negotiation rather than ______ legal action.
example.explanation: resort to意为“诉诸（某种手段）”，常含不得已的意味；respond to为“回应”，relate to为“与……有关”，resort for搭配不成立。

example.question: The newly discovered letters may ______ the author's mysterious final years.
example.explanation: shed light on为固定习语，意为“阐明”；介词必须用on；shade意为“遮蔽”，语义不通；cast light of介词错误（可作cast light on）。

chinese: 认为……理所当然；对……不重视

example.question: Don't ______ your parents' love and care ______; they deserve your gratitude.
example.explanation: take sth for granted为固定结构，意为“把……视为理所当然”；动词只能用take，且介词为for而非as。

example.question: The rumour that the old restaurant was closing ______ to be completely false.
example.explanation: turn out to be表示“结果证明是”；turn off为“关闭”，turn over为“翻转”，turn up为“出现、调高”，均不合语境。

chinese: 最终落得（某种结局）；结束

example.question: If you keep spending money like this, you'll ______ in serious debt before long.
example.explanation: wind up doing/in…表示“以……告终、最终落得”；wind down为“放松、逐渐结束”，wind in与wind over均不表示此义。

example.question: The earthquake nearly ______ the entire coastal village overnight.
example.explanation: wipe out意为“彻底摧毁、使覆灭”；wipe off指“擦掉（表面）”，wipe away为“擦去（泪水等）”，wipe up为“擦干”，程度与对象均不符。

chinese: 成功地发展；算出；制定出；锻炼

example.question: Things ______ much better than anyone had expected in the end.
example.explanation: work out在此表示“进展、结果良好”；work on为“致力于”，work up为“逐步发展、激发”，work over为“痛打”，均不合语境。

example.question: The brave soldiers refused to ______ the enemy despite being heavily outnumbered.
example.explanation: yield to sb/sth意为“屈服于”；yield up指“放弃、交出”，yield不与for/with搭配。

example.question: The invention of the smartphone ______ profound changes in the way people communicate.
example.explanation: bring about表示“引起、导致（变化）”；bring up为“抚养、提出”，bring out为“使显现、出版”，bring in为“引入、赚取”，均不搭配changes表达此义。

example.question: The worsening traffic situation ______ immediate action from the city government.
example.explanation: call for意为“需要、要求”；call on sb to do为“号召某人做”，call up为“打电话、征召”，call off为“取消”。

example.question: The researchers ______ a series of experiments to test the new drug.
example.explanation: carry out experiments为“做实验、执行实验”的固定搭配；carry on为“继续”，carry off为“赢得、成功应付”，carry away为“使入迷”。

example.question: While tidying the attic, I ______ an old photo album of my grandparents'.
example.explanation: come across意为“偶然发现”；come along为“一起来、进展”，come after为“追赶、继……而来”，come between为“离间”。

example.question: The doctor advised him to ______ fatty food in order to lower his cholesterol.
example.explanation: cut down on表示“削减、减少（摄入）”；cut down to意为“压缩到（某数量）”，cut in on为“打断”，cut off with无此搭配。

example.question: In her speech, the professor ______ twenty years of field research in Africa.
example.explanation: draw on sth意为“凭借、利用（经验等）”；draw up为“起草、使停下”，draw in为“（白昼）变短”，draw out为“拉长、掏出”。

example.question: Detectives are still trying to ______ how the thieves entered the locked museum.
example.explanation: figure out意为“弄清楚、查明”；figure in为“把……列入计算”，figure on为“指望、计划”，figure up为“计算总数”，均不合语境。

chinese: 使（观点等）被理解，讲清楚

example.question: Professor Lee is knowledgeable, but he sometimes has difficulty ______ his ideas to beginners.
example.explanation: get sth across (to sb)意为“使某事被理解”；get over为“克服、恢复”，get through为“通过、完成”，get away为“离开、逃脱”。

example.question: Those who evade taxes may think they can ______ it, but audits usually catch up with them.
example.explanation: get away with it为习语，指“做坏事而逃脱惩罚”；get along with为“与……相处”，get rid of为“摆脱”，get out of为“逃避（责任）、离开”。

chinese: 仔细检查；经历（困难）；浏览

example.question: Before signing any contract, you should ______ it carefully with a lawyer.
example.explanation: go through在此意为“仔细审阅、逐条检查”；go after为“追求”，go by为“遵循、（时间）流逝”，go for为“选择、适用于”。

example.question: Students are required to ______ their term papers by next Friday at the latest.
example.explanation: hand in papers为“上交论文”；hand out为“分发”，hand over为“移交（权力、物品）”，hand down为“传下（传统、判决）”。

example.question: She struggled to ______ her tears as she waved goodbye at the airport.
example.explanation: hold back tears为“忍住眼泪”的固定搭配；hold on为“等一下、坚持”，hold up为“举起、耽搁”，hold out为“伸出、维持”。

example.question: Even after retirement, Grandpa reads widely to ______ current affairs.
example.explanation: keep up with current affairs指“关注、了解时事动态”；keep on with为“继续做”，keep in with为“与……保持友好”，keep from为“避免”。

example.question: The car manufacturer had to ______ hundreds of workers because of falling sales.
example.explanation: lay off workers为“裁员、解雇”；lay out为“布置、铺开”，lay down为“制定（规则）、放下”，lay aside为“搁置、储蓄”。

example.question: After losing his job, he had to ______ a very small unemployment benefit.
example.explanation: live on接钱或食物，意为“靠……生活”；live by后常接某种方式或准则，live in为“住在（工作处）”，live for为“为……而活”。

example.question: A special committee has been set up to ______ the cause of the railway accident.
example.explanation: look into an accident为“调查事故”；look up为“查阅、好转”，look through为“浏览、识破”，look over为“快速查看、检阅”。

example.question: Hard work can often ______ a lack of natural talent in language learning.
example.explanation: make up for a lack of…为“弥补不足”；make up to为“讨好、弥补（某人）”，make for为“走向、促成”，make off with为“偷走”。

example.question: During her year in Florence, she ______ a good knowledge of Italian without formal lessons.
example.explanation: pick up a language表示“不经意间学会语言”；pick out为“辨认、挑选”，pick on为“找……的茬”，pick over为“仔细挑选”。

example.question: I will not ______ your constant rudeness any longer; please apologize now.
example.explanation: put up with意为“忍受”；put sb up to sth为“唆使某人做”，put forward为“提出”，put aside为“把……放在一边、储蓄”。

example.question: Most road accidents in winter ______ icy surfaces and careless driving.
example.explanation: result from后接原因，意为“起因于”；result in、lead to、bring about后均接结果，因果方向恰好相反。

example.question: The rescue team ______ food and water before help arrived on the third day.
example.explanation: run out of为及物用法，后接被耗尽的东西；run out单独使用时主语应为物（如food ran out）；run over为“碾过、溢出”，run into为“偶遇、共计”。

example.question: That morning the explorers ______ early, hoping to reach the summit before noon.
example.explanation: set out在此意为“出发、动身”；set aside为“留出、搁置”，set up为“建立”，set down为“记下、放下”。

example.question: He promised to arrive at seven, but he didn't ______ until nearly nine.
example.explanation: show up意为“出现、到场”；show off为“炫耀”，show around为“带……参观”，show out为“送……出门”。

chinese: 支持，忠于；袖手旁观；待命

example.question: Whatever the newspapers say about him, his family continues to ______ him.
example.explanation: stand by sb意为“支持、忠于某人”；stand out为“突出”，stand for为“代表、容忍”，stand up to为“勇敢面对、经得起”。

chinese: 承担（责任、工作）；呈现；雇用

example.question: After the promotion, she was unwilling to ______ any extra responsibilities.
example.explanation: take on responsibilities为“承担责任”；take in为“吸收、欺骗”，take up为“开始从事、占据”，take after为“（外貌）像”。

example.question: When the CEO retired, her eldest daughter ______ the family business.
example.explanation: take over a business为“接管企业”；take up为“开始从事、占据”，take off为“起飞、脱下、迅速成功”，take to为“开始喜欢、养成习惯”。

example.question: To everyone's surprise, he ______ the well-paid job offer to start his own studio.
example.explanation: turn down an offer为“拒绝录用/报价”；turn away为“拒之门外”，turn back为“折回”，turn off为“关闭、使反感”。

example.question: With no one else to ______, the lonely old lady often called the community hotline.
example.explanation: turn to sb意为“向某人求助”；turn over为“翻转、移交”，turn in为“上交、上床睡觉”，turn on为“打开、攻击”。

example.question: These cheap sneakers were completely ______ after only two months of daily jogging.
example.explanation: wear out指“用坏、穿破”；wear off指“（效果、疼痛）逐渐消失”，wear away指“（因摩擦而）磨损、侵蚀”，wear down指“磨短、使衰弱”。

chinese: （机器、车辆）出故障；（人）崩溃；分解

example.question: Our school bus ______ twice on the way to the museum, making us late.
example.explanation: break down指“车辆抛锚”；break up为“分手、解散”，break out为“（战争、火灾）爆发”，break in为“闯入、插话”。

example.question: After their parents died in the crash, the children were ______ by their aunt.
example.explanation: bring up在此为“抚养”，句中用被动；bring out为“使显现、出版”，bring about为“引起”，bring forward为“提前、提出”。

example.question: The open-air concert had to be ______ because of the sudden thunderstorm.
example.explanation: call off意为“取消（活动）”；call on为“拜访、号召”，call for为“需要、要求”，call up为“打电话、征召”。

example.question: Can you tell me how the quarrel between the two roommates actually ______?
example.explanation: come about意为“发生、产生”，常用于how did it come about句型；come out为“出版、结果是”，come round为“苏醒、顺便来访”，come over为“突然感到、来访”。

example.question: Injuries forced several top runners to ______ of the marathon before the finish line.
example.explanation: drop out of为“退出（比赛、学校）”；drop off为“下降、睡着、让人下车”，drop in为“顺便拜访”，drop behind为“落后”。

example.question: If you go on eating so much junk food, you'll ______ overweight and unhealthy.
example.explanation: end up后接形容词或doing，表示“最终落得……”；end in后接名词（如failure），end off为“顺利结束”，end with为“以……结束”，结构与语义均不符。

example.question: Today's lecture will ______ the causes and consequences of the French Revolution.
example.explanation: focus on为固定搭配，意为“聚焦于”；focus只能与介词on/upon搭配，其余三项均为错误介词。

example.question: It took her nearly a year to ______ the shock of the accident.
example.explanation: get over意为“从（打击、疾病）中恢复”；get across为“讲清楚”，get away为“逃脱”，get through虽可指“熬过”，但强调完成过程，从震惊中平复应用get over。

example.question: Could you give me some advice on how to ______ organizing a charity book fair?
example.explanation: go about doing sth意为“着手做某事”；go after为“追求”，go against为“违背”，go without为“没有……也行”。

example.question: The construction of the new subway line was ______ by a shortage of funds.
example.explanation: hold up在此意为“耽搁、延误”，常用被动；hold on为“等一下”，hold out为“维持、伸出”，hold back为“抑制、阻碍发展”，强调客观拖延工期应用hold up。

example.question: Please ______ the grass while the newly sown seeds are germinating.
example.explanation: keep off the grass为“请勿践踏草地”的固定说法；keep up为“保持、继续”，keep on为“持续”，keep out为“（使）不得进入”，常用keep out of结构。

chinese: 勉强辨认出；理解；开（账单）

example.question: The fog was so thick that we could barely ______ the road signs ahead.
example.explanation: make out在此意为“勉强看清、辨认”；make for为“走向、促成”，make off为“匆忙逃走”，make over为“翻新、转让”。

example.question: The famous novelist ______ peacefully at her country home at the age of ninety-two.
example.explanation: pass away是“去世”的委婉说法，符合讣告语境；pass out为“昏倒、分发”，pass by为“经过、忽视”，pass down为“传下来”。

example.question: Critics were quick to ______ that the survey was based on very limited data.
example.explanation: point out后可接that从句，意为“指出（事实、错误）”；point to/at后接具体对象，意为“指向”，point up为“强调、凸显”，不接that从句。

chinese: 直到……才……（not until置于句首时主句部分倒装）

example.question: Not until the train pulled out of the station ______ that she had left her laptop on the seat.
example.explanation: not until位于句首时主句须部分倒装，借助助动词did；“意识到”发生在火车驶出之后，应用一般过去时而非过去完成时，故选did she realize。

chinese: 要不是因为……（对过去的虚拟，倒装省略if）

example.question: ______ your timely warning, we would have walked straight into the trap.
example.explanation: 主句would have walked表示对过去的虚拟，条件句应为if it had not been for，省略if后倒装成had it not been for；B、C指对现在的虚拟，D否定词位置错误。

example.question: ______ that online learning has become an essential part of modern education.
example.explanation: there is no denying that为固定句型；denying是动名词，须用there be引导，不能用形式主语it；no doubt后接that不接whether；D结构残缺。

example.question: Suddenly ______ that she had completely forgotten to lock the front door.
example.explanation: occur表示“被想到”时以it作形式主语，真正主语是that从句，且人之前必须加介词to；occur为不及物动词，不能用被动，故其余三项均误。

example.question: ______ you practise speaking English, ______ you will become.
example.explanation: “the＋比较级，the＋比较级”表示“越……越……”；become为系动词，后接形容词confident而不是副词confidently，故B错；C、D缺少the或误用最高级。

chinese: 使我惊讶的是……（what引导名词性从句）

example.question: ______ was that the shy new boy gave the best speech of the whole contest.
example.explanation: what引导主语从句并在从句中作主语，相当于the thing that；that引导主语从句时不在从句中充当成分；which表选择，it不能同时充当先行词。

chinese: 早该做……了（从句用一般过去时表虚拟）

example.question: It is high time that the city council ______ firm measures against air pollution.
example.explanation: it is (high) time that句型中，从句谓语须用一般过去时（或should＋动词原形，should不可省但不常见），表示“早该做了”；现在时、将来时和完成时均不符合此虚拟结构。

chinese: 如此……以至于……（so＋形容词/副词置于句首时主句倒装）

example.question: ______ that the audience burst into applause before she finished speaking.
options: Her speech was so moving as
example.explanation: so＋形容词置于句首表示强调时，主句须部分倒装：so moving was her speech；B语序未倒装；such后须接名词短语；so…as不引导结果状语从句。

english: only＋状语置于句首引起倒装

example.question: Only after you have paid the registration fee ______ allowed to choose your courses.
example.explanation: only修饰状语从句置于句首时，主句须部分倒装；主句描述缴费之后的将来情形，用will you be allowed；B、C未倒装，D结构错误。

chinese: 一……就……（hardly置于句首时主句过去完成时倒装）

example.question: Hardly ______ the house when it began to pour with rain.
example.explanation: hardly位于句首时主句部分倒装，且“离开”发生在“下雨”之前，须用过去完成时had I left；when从句用一般过去时；C时态错误，B未倒装。

chinese: 一……就……（no sooner置于句首时主句过去完成时倒装）

example.question: No sooner ______ asleep than a loud knock at the door woke him up.
example.explanation: no sooner位于句首时主句部分倒装，且“入睡”先于“敲门声”，用过去完成时had he fallen；连词用than，从句用一般过去时；C时态不符，B、D未倒装。

chinese: 假如……（对现在/将来的虚拟，were提前）

example.question: ______ given the chance, I would definitely study medicine rather than law.
example.explanation: 此句相当于if I were given the chance，对与现在事实相反的情况虚拟，be动词一律用were，省略if时将were提前；had I后应接过去分词构成完成结构，与此处given配合语义不符。

example.question: It was in the small village library ______ his love of reading first took root.
example.explanation: 被强调部分是地点状语in the small village library，强调句只能用that（强调人时可用who），去掉it was…that后句子依然完整；where和in which引导定语从句，但句中不缺先行词关系。

example.question: The secret of happiness is not to do what one likes, ______ to like what one has to do.
example.explanation: not…but…为并列连词结构，意为“不是……而是……”，前后成分须对称；and表并列、or表选择、yet表转折但不与not构成此固定结构。

example.question: It is no use ______ over spilt milk; what we need now is a practical solution.
example.explanation: it is no use后须接动名词作真正主语，构成it is no use doing sth；crying over spilt milk也是英语谚语“覆水难收”，不定式与动词原形均不合此句型。

english: There is no point in doing

example.question: There is no point in ______ him to change his mind once he has made a decision.
example.explanation: there is no point in中的in为介词，后接动名词；“试图说服”为try to persuade，故综合为trying to persuade；B、C、D的动词形式均不能作介词宾语。

chinese: 真正重要的是……（what引导主语从句）

example.question: ______ in the long run is not the score of a single exam but the habit of lifelong learning.
example.explanation: what引导主语从句并在从句中作主语，相当于the thing that；that引导主语从句时不充当成分；it不能引导从句作主语；which表选择范围，均不合适。

chinese: 如此……以至于……（such后接名词短语）

example.question: The lecturer made ______ informative speech that most students stayed behind to ask questions.
example.explanation: speech为可数名词单数，informative以元音音素开头，故用such an；such修饰名词短语，so修饰形容词或副词，故so an和so结构错误，such a冠词音素不符。

english: as引导非限制性定语从句
chinese: 正如……（as指代整个主句，可位于句首）

example.question: ______ is often the case with beginners, Tom tried to memorize every new word mechanically.
example.explanation: as引导非限制性定语从句，可位于句首并指代整个主句，意为“正如”；which引导此类从句不能置于句首；that不能引导非限制性定语从句；it不能起连接作用。

english: however＋形容词/副词引导让步状语

example.question: ______, the rescue workers refused to give up searching for the missing climbers.
example.explanation: however引导让步状语从句时语序为however＋形容词/副词＋主语＋谓语；B语序错误；no matter后须接how；although引导从句不倒装，C、D均不成立。

chinese: 本（不）该做……（对过去行为的责备或后悔）

example.question: You ______ the confidential report to anyone outside the department; it was a serious breach of rules.
example.explanation: shouldn't have done表示“本不该做却做了”，带责备意味，符合泄密事实；needn't have done为“本不必做却做了”；can't have done表对过去的否定推测；mustn't show时态不符。

example.question: With artificial intelligence developing so fast, it won't be long ______ self-driving cars become common.
example.explanation: it won't be long before…为固定句型，意为“不久以后就会……”；when不用于此结构，it is/has been＋时间＋since表“自从……已有多久”，until与not连用通常修饰终止性动作，均不符。

example.question: A true expert can readily ______ an original painting from a clever forgery.
example.explanation: distinguish A from B意为“辨别A与B”；distract为“使分心”，distort为“歪曲、扭曲”，disguise为“伪装”，均为形近干扰项，语义不符。

example.question: Environmentalists urge people not to ______ used batteries carelessly, as they contain harmful chemicals.
example.explanation: discard指“随手丢弃（废弃物）”；discharge为“排放、放行”，dismiss为“解雇、不予考虑”，dissolve为“溶解、解散”，均不合乱扔垃圾的语境。

chinese: 排放（液体、气体）；准许离开；履行（职责）

example.question: The factory was fined for illegally ______ untreated waste water into the nearby river.
example.explanation: discharge专指“排放（废水、废气）”，符合工厂排污语境；discard为“丢弃（固体物）”，drain为“排干（积水）”，dismiss为“解雇、解散”。

example.question: The new subway line will save commuters a ______ amount of travel time every day.
example.explanation: a considerable amount of为“相当多的”，修饰数量；considerate形容人“体贴的”；considering为介词“考虑到”；considered为“经过深思熟虑的”。

example.question: It was very ______ of you to give up your seat to the pregnant woman on the crowded bus.
example.explanation: it is considerate of sb to do sth形容某人行为“体贴周到”；considerable指数量“可观的”；conservative为“保守的”；conventional为“传统的”，均不形容此举。

chinese: 节约使用，保护（资源、能源）

example.question: Residents are being asked to ______ water during the unusually dry summer months.
example.explanation: conserve强调节约、合理使用资源（conserve water/energy为常用搭配）；preserve强调使完好保存、免受破坏；reserve为“预留、预订”；observe为“观察、遵守”。

example.question: Salt has long been used to ______ meat and fish in regions without refrigeration.
example.explanation: preserve指“保存、防腐”，腌制食品正属此义；conserve侧重节约使用资源；reserve为“预订、储备”；deserve为“值得”，为形近干扰。

example.question: I'd like to ______ a table for four by the window for this Saturday evening.
example.explanation: reserve a table为“预订餐位”的固定表达；preserve、conserve强调保存或节约，不用于订座；retain为“保留、保持（原有状态）”，不接table表示预订。

example.question: Having once been cheated online, the elderly man was ______ to give out any personal information.
example.explanation: be reluctant to do sth意为“不情愿做某事”，后接不定式；be resistant后须接to加名词；irrelevant为“不相关的”；indifferent为“漠不关心的”，通常接to。

chinese: 中立的，不偏不倚的；中性的

example.question: A good referee must remain ______ and never show favour to either side.
example.explanation: remain neutral指“保持中立”，与不偏袒任何一方呼应；natural为“自然的”；mutual为“相互的”；central为“中心的”，均为形近或语义干扰。

example.question: Critics complained that the selection of prize winners seemed completely ______, with no clear criteria.
example.explanation: arbitrary指“随心所欲、没有标准的”，与no clear criteria呼应；deliberate为“故意的”；compulsory为“强制的”；temporary为“临时的”，语义均不符。

chinese: 故意的，蓄意的；从容谨慎的

example.question: The police believe the fire was ______ rather than the result of an electrical fault.
example.explanation: deliberate指“蓄意的”，与“电路故障（意外）”形成对照；delicate为“精致的、脆弱的”；desperate为“绝望的、拼命的”；dense为“密集的”，均为形近干扰。

example.question: The committee voted to ______ the new safety regulations from the beginning of next year.
example.explanation: adopt regulations为“采纳、通过规章”；adapt为“适应、改编”；adept为形容词“熟练的”；adjust为“调整”，后接to，均为近形近义干扰。

example.question: Even his opponents had to ______ that his argument was both clear and well supported.
example.explanation: acknowledge that…意为“承认……（属实）”；acquire为“获得”；advocate为“提倡”；allocate为“分配”，均不能接that从句表达承认之义。

example.question: After hours of tough negotiation, both sides finally reached a ______ acceptable to all.
example.explanation: reach a compromise为“达成妥协”的固定搭配；promise为“承诺”；comprehension为“理解”；composition为“作文、构成”，均为形近干扰。

chinese: 传统的，因循守旧的；常规的

example.question: Despite her ______ upbringing, she chose a career that shocked her small hometown.
example.explanation: conventional upbringing指“传统守旧的家教”，与震惊乡邻形成转折；convenient为“方便的”；controversial为“有争议的”；confident为“自信的”，语义均不衔接。

chinese: 更好的，更优越的（superior to）；上级的

example.question: This new material is vastly ______ to traditional steel in both strength and weight.
example.explanation: be superior to为固定搭配，意为“优于”，本身含比较意义，不加more；senior to为“年长于、级别高于”；prior to为“在……之前”；inferior to为“劣于”，语义相反。

chinese: 最终，终于（强调经过较长过程）

example.question: Although he failed the driving test twice, Mark ______ passed on his third attempt.
example.explanation: eventually强调经历波折后“最终”成功；accidentally为“意外地”；temporarily为“暂时地”；deliberately为“故意地”，均与两次失败后终获成功的语境不符。
